`hooks/command-safety.sh` uses `COMMAND_SAFETY_DENY_PATTERN` to reject matches at executable command positions. Quoted arguments and here-document data pass. An absent setting applies the hook's default, which refuses a `systemd-run` memory cap in kilobytes or megabytes; the value `^$` turns matching off. An explicitly empty or invalid pattern, missing tools, or unreadable input or settings produces one keyed warning and allows the call.
